title: Concept: AWS account identifier in a response
description: A twelve-digit account identifier in a JSON field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The account id is the anchor for cross-account trust and support requests, so publishing it lets an attacker craft a believable support or trust-policy pretext.
applicability: Deployments that render a twelve-digit account identifier in a JSON field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The account id is the anchor for cross-account trust and support requests, so publishing it lets an attacker craft a believable support or trust-policy pretext.
